descriptions.zh: > ACK支持修改节点池内节点的kubelet配置。修改完成后，节点池的节点会自动生效，节点池新增节点也将使用新的配置。
descriptions.en: > ACK supports modifying the kubelet configurations of nodes in a node pool. After the modification, the new configurations automatically take effect on existing nodes in the node pool. New nodes added to the node pool also use the new configurations.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cs modify-node-pool-node-config --cluster-id c23421cfa74454bc8b37163fd19af0000 --nodepool-id np8d8c9c2cd0f64e89884f82a5fbcd0000 --kubelet-config example-string --rolling-policy max_parallelism=3 --os-config '{"hugepage":"example-string","sysctl":{"key":"example-string"}}' --containerd-config example-string --node-names cn-beijing.10.180.xx.xx --region cn-hangzhou
